text: On data_seed 1 at e<=0.9, the headroom-normalised force margin (0.26-0.32) roughly equals the normalised accel_step margin (0.27-0.30) in every seed (ratio about 0.87-1.10), while on data_seed 0 it was well below it. Read at a fixed layer (layer 4) in both datasets, does the ratio of force to accel_step normalised margin depend on the dataset, and does the data_seed 1 force advantage come from lower force controls (0.17-0.31) rather than higher trained R2?
